name: Kagi Assistant
desc: Answer mode on top of Kagi's own paid search index
desc_zh: 基于 Kagi 自有索引的问答模式
solves: A general engine answers out of ads and SEO. Kagi Assistant answers from Kagi's own index and links every claim back to a page.
solves_zh: 通用搜索引擎的答案里混着广告和 SEO。Kagi Assistant 用自建索引回答，每条结论都指回具体页面。
best_for: Already paying for Kagi Search and wanting the answer mode with links.
best_for_zh: 已经在付费订阅 Kagi Search，想再加一个带链接的问答模式。
